description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class which implements the IBasketViewModelService interface. It provides methods to retrieve, create, and map basket data for web presentation, utilizing repositories, specifications, and URI composition.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling basket view models, including retrieval, creation, mapping, and counting items.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for the specified user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for the specified user.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Generates basket item view models from basket items, fetching catalog details and composing image URIs.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel, including basket items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total count of basket items for a given user.
